title: Neural Stem Cell Treatment for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A multicenter, randomized placebo controlled and biological endpoints clinical Trial
official: Neural Stem Cell Treatment for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A multicenter, randomized placebo controlled and biological endpoints clinical Trial
summary: Main objective: The primary trial outcome is safety, assessed with respect to the incidence of treatment-emergent AEs (TEAEs) and serious AEs (SAEs) over the whole study period. AEs are coded using MedDRA and they should be reported to competent authorities only if unexpected and related to Intracerebroventricular administration of human Neural Stem Cells.
